description: Port the GenOffice engine and shared packages VERBATIM into redrob-office/packages/. These are pure-TS (no Electron) packages that every editor app depends on: docx-engine (40K), pptx-engine (35K), pptx-render (14K), pdf2docx (31K), file-parse, font-metrics, i18n, ui, electron-utils, agent-core, ai-search, project-store. This is a straight copy of original source, not a rewrite. ai-provider is intentionally EXCLUDED here (its Redrob replacement is FEAT-009).
steps: Copy each GenOffice package directory verbatim from /projects/sandbox/_refs/genoffice/packages/<pkg> into /projects/sandbox/redrob-office/packages/<pkg> for: docx-engine, pptx-engine, pptx-render, pdf2docx, file-parse, font-metrics, i18n, ui (as @genoffice/ui - keep separate from the existing @redrob/ui), electron-utils, agent-core, ai-search, project-store. Preserve directory structure, tests/, package.json, tsconfig, and any fixtures. Keep the @genoffice/* package names for now (rebranding is FEAT-010).
Do NOT copy packages/ai-provider (replaced by Redrob layer in FEAT-009).

Copy the GenOffice tooling that these packages/tests need: tools/*.mjs referenced by package scripts (e.g. build-stale-preloads, check-english-comments) and any python font tools referenced by font-metrics build steps - copy them into repo tools/ (idempotent with FEAT-001).

Run `pnpm install` so the new @genoffice/* workspace packages are linked. Resolve peer/version conflicts by keeping GenOffice's declared versions (these packages own their own deps); do not force them onto the existing office app's React 18.

Generate docx-engine fixtures if the package's tests require them: run the package's fixtures script (equivalent of `npm run fixtures -w @genoffice/docx-engine`) via pnpm filter. Record the exact command.

Run typecheck and tests for the newly copied packages via `pnpm --filter '@genoffice/*' typecheck` and `pnpm --filter '@genoffice/*' test` (or turbo scoped). Fix only integration/wiring issues (module resolution, workspace linking); do NOT alter the engines' original logic.
acceptance_criteria: All listed @genoffice/* packages exist under packages/ with their original source, tests, and package.json intact (verify a representative file count roughly matches source, e.g. docx-engine ~40K lines).
`pnpm install` links the new workspace packages with exit 0.
The copied packages' own vitest suites pass (run scoped to @genoffice/* packages).
The pre-existing @redrob/office and @redrob/* packages still typecheck and test green (no regression).
verification: `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22; pnpm install` exits 0
`pnpm typecheck` at repo root still passes (existing + new packages)
findings:
COPIED VERBATIM into packages/ from /projects/sandbox/_refs/genoffice/packages/ (via `cp -a`, no source edits): docx-engine, pptx-engine, pptx-render, pdf2docx, file-parse, font-metrics, i18n, electron-utils, agent-core, ai-search, project-store. The GenOffice `ui` package (@genoffice/ui) was copied to packages/genoffice-ui/ (NOT packages/ui/) to coexist with the existing @redrob/ui at packages/ui/ - package name is still @genoffice/ui so resolution is unaffected by the dir name. ai-provider intentionally NOT copied (FEAT-009 replaces it). Package.json names kept as @genoffice/* (rebrand is a later feature).

TOOLS: copied all remaining GenOffice tools/* into repo tools/ idempotently, skipping the two FEAT-001 already added (check-licenses.mjs, gen-third-party-notices.mjs). Newly added: build-gothic-kr-font.py, build-kr-che-latin-font.py, build-poppins-font.py, build-pua-blank-font.py, build-stale-preloads.mjs, build-tamil-font.py, check-english-comments.mjs, check-theme-colors.mjs, format-changed.mjs, gen-file-association-icons.mjs, gen-linespacing-probe.py, normalize-kr-latin-metrics.py, normalize-kr-sans-hmtx.py, patch-carlito-vi.py, scale-kr-sans-latin-ink.py.

WIRING FIXES (workspace/module-resolution only, no engine logic touched):
1) Internal @genoffice cross-deps declared as bare "*" (npm-workspaces style) do not resolve on pnpm; rewrote them to "workspace:*" in docx-engine, file-parse, genoffice-ui, pdf2docx, pptx-render (deps: @genoffice/pptx-engine, docx-engine, font-metrics, i18n, pptx-render).
2) vitest@^4.1.0 (GenOffice's declared version) has a peerDependency vite ^6||^7||^8; the merged workspace only hoisted the office app's vite@5, so vitest failed at runtime with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED './module-runner'. Added `"vite": "^7.3.1"` (the version GenOffice apps declare) as a devDependency to the 11 @genoffice packages that run vitest. This scopes vite 7 to the @genoffice packages and does NOT touch the office app's vite 5 / React 18.
3) @genoffice/electron-utils tests and src import `electron`; under pnpm's isolated node_modules it was not visible (GenOffice relied on npm flat hoisting). Added `"electron": "^35.5.1"` (office app's version) as a devDependency.
4) @genoffice/pdf2docx test helper tests/helpers/fixtures.ts imports `pdf-lib` (provided by GenOffice apps, not the package). Added `"pdf-lib": "^1.17.1"` as a devDependency.
5) TSConfig: the copied packages `extends ../../tsconfig.base.json`, but redrob-office's base uses moduleResolution NodeNext (requires explicit .js import extensions) while GenOffice code is authored for moduleResolution bundler. Created tsconfig.genoffice.base.json at repo root = a verbatim copy of GenOffice's tsconfig.base.json (module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, lib ES2022) and repointed the 12 @genoffice package tsconfigs' `extends` to it. The 8 @redrob package tsconfigs are unchanged (still use tsconfig.base.json). Also added lib ["ES2022","DOM","DOM.Iterable"] to electron-utils/tsconfig.json (its drop-open.ts is a renderer bridge using DOM globals; GenOffice's flat node_modules exposed DOM ambiently, and genoffice-ui/ai-search already carry a DOM lib override so this matches the existing pattern).

COMMANDS RUN (Node 22 via nvm, pnpm 10.28.1):
- `pnpm install` -> exit 0 (workspace packages linked, no peer warnings after fixes).
- FIXTURES: `pnpm --filter '@genoffice/docx-engine' fixtures` -> wrote fixtures to /projects/sandbox/redrob-office/fixtures/generated (6 .docx files: kitchen-sink, simple, visual-captable-{float,inline,page-anchor,pct}). GenOffice tracks these generated fixtures in-repo, so they are committed.

TEST RESULTS (all @genoffice suites):
- docx-engine: 87 files, 995 passed, 1 skipped.
- pptx-engine: 81 files, 836 passed.
- pptx-render: 10 files, 245 passed.
- pdf2docx: 45 files, 699 passed, 7 skipped.
- file-parse: 3 files, 30 passed.
- font-metrics: 3 files, 13 passed.
- i18n: 1 file, 17 passed.
- agent-core: 4 files, 77 passed.
- ai-search: 3 files, 50 passed.
- project-store: 1 file, 61 passed.
- electron-utils: 8 of 9 files pass (121 of 122 tests). ONE test fails: tests/default-save-dir.test.ts > 'degrades to the fallback when the configured folder is not writable'. ENVIRONMENTAL, not a port defect: the test chmods a dir to 0o500 and expects a write to fail, but the sandbox runs as root and root bypasses Linux DAC write permissions, so the write succeeds. The source file is unchanged (verbatim). This test cannot pass as root regardless of the port; it would pass as a non-root user. genoffice-ui has no test script (typecheck only).

TYPECHECK: `pnpm typecheck` at repo root -> 29/29 turbo tasks successful, including @redrob/office and all 12 @genoffice packages. No regression.

REGRESSION CHECK: `pnpm --filter '@redrob/*' test` -> all green: kernel 100, registry 18, store 10, ui 20, telemetry 7, generate 10, extract 3, compare 16, and @redrob/office 946 passed / 6 skipped. (The 'Slow server' MCP line in office output is an intentional test log, the file suite passed.)
